meta.method: Unigram token recall (fraction of value tokens in evidence token set). String args only; numeric/bool excluded. Provenance evidence (premise + earlier tool outputs). ISO date and currency special handlers applied first.
meta.caveat: Token recall is a looser proxy than difflib fuzzy ratio — it ignores token order. It correctly captures the PARAPHRASE bucket (words present but reordered/rephrased) but may over-credit cases where a few unrelated tokens coincidentally match. FBR on confirmed-correct calls only cannot be measured without labels on this split.
